subject: running out of memeory while using SCANTWO

messages.author: 327a8e5641d73ebe
messages.subject: running out of memeory while using SCANTWO
parts:
Hi,

This may be more of an R question, but it comes up while using scantwo,
so here goes. I am getting error message indicating R is running out
of memory:

1: Reached total allocation of 767Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: Reached total allocation of 767Mb: see help(memory.size)

I have increased the virtual memory used by Windows (1152-4000mb) and
set the memory size as large as R will let me:

> memory.limit(size=4000)

Now when I run scantwo, I get errors like the following:

Error: cannot allocate vector of size 66560 Kb

I am running Windows XP on a P4 3.2Ghz laptop with 768MB ram. My
dataset has N=640, 243 markers on 5 chromosomes, 1 phenotype and 1
additive covariate, and I imputed pseudomarkers on 256 pages at 2cM
intervals. I am using method="imp" for scantwo. When I do MIM on QTL
cartographer, my computer handles this dataset fine and takes somewhere
between 12-20 hrs to analyze.

How can I get R/qtl to analyze my data? Is there any way to increase
R's memory limits?

Thank you

Tarek

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: running out of memeory while using SCANTWO
parts:
You're running out of memory. The 256 imputations take a lot
of memory, especially at 2 cM resolution.

Your options are: use the "em" method rather than imputation
("em" is equivalent to MIM in QTL Cartographer.); do fewer
imputations; use a bigger step size; or get a computer with
more RAM.

karl
